main_text.p: firmitatem affectantibus, lectionem historia-rum prætera commendarem Justini, qui magnum scriptorem, Trogum Pompejum compilavit, & res Græcas Latino sermone compendiosè perstrinxit : Flori, in quo dictio elegans & florida, ac nullibiferè non Poëtam arguens, apparet. Agmen claudat Crispus Sallustius, qui magis elaboratis verbis, & sententiis ad argumenti majestatem compositis res magnas effatur ! Vel cui acrius est judicium, Cornelius Tacitus, maximi nominis historicus, & nunquam sine maxima cura legendus. Quamvis ipse Principum artes & arcana tam alte indagaverit, ut non tantum priorum facundiam, sed & posterorum omnium imitationem, sit supergressus.

Præstant & alia, non infima historiæ lumina, sermonis flumina. Novi Livium magnæ molis historicorum principem: Novi Cæsarem, simplicissimæ elegantiæ Imperatorem: Novi alios absque suspensa hædera, vel solo nomine vendibiles. page.notes: The page number "18" at the head is set with a small decorative mark and is read as 18 with some doubt. The word "Præstant" is set with a small blot over the "n" of "non infima", which is read as "infima". Faint show-through from the reverse side appears in the left half of the page and is left out.
